descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for a skilled BI Developer with strong expertise in SQL/PL/SQL and Power BI to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing and modeling data, developing interactive reports and dashboards, and delivering meaningful business insights to support data-driven decision-making. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders and proficiency in both German and English.
Responsibilities 
Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL and PL/SQL queries to ensure efficient data retrieval and processing.
Analyze, prepare, transform, and model data to support business intelligence and reporting requirements.
Design, develop, and maintain interactive reports, dashboards, and KPI analyses using Power BI.
Create and optimize DAX calculations, measures, and metrics to support business reporting needs.
Gather and analyze business requirements related to reporting, data visualization, and business intelligence.
Collaborate with business departments and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into effective BI solutions.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data used in reports and dashboards.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting processes and business intelligence solutions.
 Requirements 
Extensive experience working with SQL and/or PL/SQL.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, including report and dashboard development.
Proven experience creating reports, dashboards, and data analyses for business users.
Good knowledge of DAX for developing calculations, measures, and KPIs.
Previous experience working in a Business Intelligence environment.
Understanding of data analysis, data modeling, and reporting processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.
Good command of both German and English .
 Nice to Have 
Experience with JasperReports.
Familiarity with GitLab and version control practices.
Knowledge of Angular.
Experience with Node.js.
Understanding of data warehouse architectures and ETL processes.
